intro: Egypt is almost entirely desert, but the Nile River creates a long green strip where nearly everyone lives.

chapters.title: The gift of the Nile
text: The Nile flows north through Egypt for over 1,500 km to a wide delta on the Mediterranean. About 95% of Egyptians live along the river or in the delta, on a few per cent of the land.
The Aswan High Dam, finished in 1970, stopped the yearly floods and created Lake Nasser.

chapters.title: Deserts and Sinai
text: The Western Desert has oases such as Siwa and the White Desert's chalk shapes. The Sinai Peninsula, with Mount Sinai, links Africa and Asia, and the Red Sea coast has coral reefs.

keyTerms.meaning: Flat land where a river splits before the sea.
A green, watered place in a desert.
